description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a UI Fragment that contains a custom LogView for displaying log data within an Android application. It manages view inflation, layout setup, and text change handling to facilitate logging within the app.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass responsible for displaying a log view inside a scrollable container, with methods to initialize and manage its internal views.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding, then returns the assembled view hierarchy.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's method to inflate views, attach a TextWatcher for auto-scrolling, and return the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the internal LogView instance for external interaction.
